exposure: Delivery method (any vaginal vs all caesarean sections)
Pilates-based pelvic floor muscle training classes and a DVD for home use
Prolapse stage (above the hymen vs at or beyond the hymen)
Parity (three or less vs more than three deliveries)
outcome: Self-reported prolapse symptoms (Pelvic Organ Prolapse Symptom Score [POP-SS])
cohort: 414 women with stage 1-3 prolapse who had not sought treatment
finding: Pelvic floor muscle training leads to a small, but potentially important, reduction in prolapse symptoms in women with stage 1-3 prolapse.
mod_finding: Women were randomized to intervention and control groups based in part on delivery method (vaginal vs Cesarean).
